alt: An E2PDF Call Log Report from Nicolas Hernandez's mobile phone, detailing outbound calls made on June 18, 2026, to John Wesley Health Centers (JWCH) numbers and out-of-network control lines, proving a system-wide clinic PBX/SIP trunking failure and carrier intercepts.
summary: A forensic E2PDF Call Log Report demonstrating outbound call attempts on June 18, 2026. Outbound calls to John Wesley Health Centers (JWCH) regional numbers (Bellflower, Lancaster, and toll-free main lines) returned zero-second durations and carrier-level intercepts, while out-of-network control group calls connected successfully, proving system-wide network inaccessibility.
